verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has a dedicated CKS quotas page covering the whole story: viewing quotas in the Cloud Console, reading quota errors when a Node Pool exceeds its quota, and requesting an increase for more capacity. The evidence is a single summary sentence from that page, so the depth of the documented limits and of the increase process is not shown. Missing for 10: the specific per-instance-type limit values, details of the increase workflow (channel, turnaround, programmatic or API request path), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
